rows.predecessor_quote: Every new or materially changed active semantic boundary must derive its semantic model from one accepted Ontology.
rows.successor_quote: Every new or materially changed active semantic boundary derives its semantic model from one accepted Ontology (P1, P6)
rows.what_changed: No determination change. Reprice invalidation is bound as an instance of ACTIVATION §7's material input change; an Ontology composition definition and 'inventory alone is not an Ontology' are added.

rows.predecessor_quote: A topological or effect boundary must first be derived and accepted as a Prime atom.
rows.successor_quote: A topological or effect boundary is first derived and accepted as a Prime atom.

rows.predecessor_quote: Before the affected boundary is promoted or claims design-method closure, the Ontology and IACS must be accepted and the typed implementation reconciled to them.
rows.successor_quote: Before the affected boundary is promoted or claims design-method closure, the Ontology and IACS are accepted and the typed implementation is reconciled to them.
rows.what_changed: No determination change. Adds that the IACS is the carrier inventory to which ASSURANCE §2, §7 and §15 bind conformance tests and unit proof.

rows.predecessor_quote: A Subordinate Payload may be promoted to a top-level type only when at least one of the following is true
rows.successor_quote: A Subordinate Payload may be promoted to a top-level type only when at least one of these is true

rows.predecessor_quote: If a schema or ticket lists a wide family of types, it must distinguish: the Irreducible Architectural Carrier Set; Subordinate Payloads.
rows.successor_quote: If a schema or ticket lists a wide family of types, it distinguishes the IACS from the Subordinate Payloads

rows.predecessor_quote: design-method completion must not rest on code comparison alone.
rows.successor_quote: design-method completion does not rest on code comparison alone

rows.predecessor_quote: must carry one accepted Ontology and one complete three-view Mermaid design asset before the boundary is promoted or claims design-method closure.
rows.successor_quote: carries one accepted Ontology and one complete three-view Mermaid design asset before the boundary is promoted or claims design-method closure

rows.predecessor_quote: the canonical evidence relation is: constitutional WHAT and owning requirements -> Ontology, IACS, target design, and three-view evidence -> implementation and module-derived unit tests
rows.successor_quote: For a new or materially changed realisation boundary governed by a design profile (DESIGN_MODULE, tier 3 ...), the canonical evidence relation is
rows.what_changed: No determination change. Relocated to ASSURANCE §14 with generic terms (carrier inventory; domain, sequence and state evidence; co-evolution condition) bound to IACS, three views and co_evolution_admissible(B) by the design profile; handoff relation now ACTIVATION §1.

rows.predecessor_quote: If a module has code but no module-derived unit test lane, the module is not closure-ready under this method.
rows.successor_quote: If a module has code but no module-derived unit test lane, the module is not closure-ready under the design profile.
rows.what_changed: No determination change. Relocated to ASSURANCE §15; concept ownership stays with the design profile; bounded context now declared by ASSURANCE §2 rather than SPEC_METHOD.

rows.predecessor_quote: the module may still proceed only when that gap is explicitly governed. It may not close by relying on local convention
rows.successor_quote: the module may still proceed only when that gap is explicitly governed; it may not close by relying on local convention
rows.what_changed: No determination change. 'graph function, or GTL module' generalised to 'published function or module of a profile' (still covered by 'every designed function'); the three phase answers are now sourced from SPEC_METHOD §2.

rows.predecessor_quote: Otherwise only a disposable spike may supply evidence across the affected unresolved, contradictory, or materially non-equivalent relation before its design is accepted.
rows.successor_quote: Otherwise only a disposable spike may supply evidence across the affected unresolved, contradictory or materially non-equivalent relation before its design is accepted.

rows.predecessor_quote: Composition must not widen authority implicitly. A composed or higher-order function has no more authority than the authority law admitted for its inputs
rows.successor_quote: Composition does not widen authority implicitly: a composed or higher-order function has no more authority than the authority law admitted for its inputs
rows.what_changed: No determination change. The 'what creates no authority' items are stated once in FOUNDATIONS §2 and applied here; delegation/elevation/transfer/retirement also carry FOUNDATIONS' explicit authority decision.

rows.predecessor_quote: Every seam crossing the affected set must either include its causally relevant far-side relation in that set, or state why that relation cannot affect
rows.successor_quote: far side can causally affect, or be affected by, the action is inside the cone unless the basis establishes that it cannot participate
rows.what_changed: No determination change. The seam rule is carried by reference to ACTIVATION §1 Execution unit: 'state why it cannot affect/be affected' becomes 'basis establishes it cannot participate'; same inclusion criterion, exclusion still grounded.

rows.predecessor_quote: The design pack must evaluate every applicable product, graph, language, runtime, handler, and module axiom with one of: pass; fail; or not_applicable, with a reason.
rows.successor_quote: The design pack evaluates every applicable product, graph, language, runtime, handler and module axiom with one of pass, fail or not_applicable with a reason
rows.what_changed: No determination reversed. Adds a self-declared new core-value mapping: not_applicable's reason names basis-bound facts and the excluding authority; an evaluated axiom reaching no verdict records indeterminate/out_of_frame/invalid_basis, never pass.

rows.predecessor_quote: Contradictory projections make the design unsatisfiable and block promotion.
rows.successor_quote: Contradictory projections make the design unsatisfiable and block promotion (P1, P5): an unsatisfiable design fails the design gate's acceptance criterion
rows.what_changed: No determination change. Adds that decision completeness is the design gate's acceptance criterion and that the unsatisfiability block is a gate precondition, not a review-finding decision.
